professionalSummary: Experienced compliance administrator with a proven track record of maintaining statutory inspection calendars, auditing subcontractor permits, investigating site incidents, and preparing detailed compliance reports for a portfolio of 48 client sites.
experienceHighlights: Maintained statutory inspection calendar for 48 client sites in CAFM system and chased overdue inspections with contractors.
Audited subcontractor permits for roof access and hot works, ensuring method statements were met before release.
Investigated site incidents with area managers, documented corrective actions, and tracked closure.
Prepared quarterly compliance reports for client account managers.
Scheduled monthly toolbox talks and managed fire-warden rota.
projectsAndWorkSamples: An anonymised incident investigation file for a slip on a wet floor, detailing timeline, witness notes, root cause, corrective actions, and area manager closure sign‑off.

evidence.text: kept the statutory inspection calendar for 48 client sites in the CAFM system and chased contractors whenever a lift, fire-alarm or gas-safety inspection passed its due date.

Checked subcontractor permits to work for roof access and hot works against the method statement before the job was released, and returned incomplete permits to the contractor with the missing items marked.

Worked on incident investigations with the area managers, interviewing site staff, photographing the scene and entering the corrective actions in the incident log, then following each action until it was closed.

An anonymised incident investigation file for a slip on a wet floor at a retail site, containing the timeline, witness notes, root cause (warning signage removed during cleaning), the corrective actions and the area manager's closure sign-off.
evidence.notes: Illustrates reporting of corrective actions; aligns with quarterly compliance reporting

evidence.text: The candidate supplied a NEBOSH National General Certificate at screening; its certificate number was checked on NEBOSH's online verification service, which shows the award on 14 June 2023 in the candidate's name.
